name: Fiem Industries Ltd
about: Fiem Industries Ltd was originally incorporated in India as Rahul Auto Private Limited on February 6, 1989, in New Delhi and was founded by Mr. J.K. Jain. It is engaged in the business manufacturing and supply of auto components like automotive lighting. [1]
keyPoints:
Market Leader
Co. enjoys a significant market share for supply of automotive lighting & signaling equipment and rearview mirrors to Two-wheeler and Four-wheeler OEMs[1] In FY19, they had 27-30% market share of the total 2 Wheeler headlamp market in India. [2], which increased to 30%+ in FY22[3]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 21.9% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 32.8%
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -4.44%
